  • Handle incidents and issues through to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets and balance workloads.
  • Work on projects in sprints with Jira; apply agile methods and align work to team and company goals.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results with minimal direction.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tooling (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; API integration experience.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; hardware shipping and customs familiarity.
  • Strong communication skills across media; clear, friendly, concise writing; culturally aware.
  • Commitment to security (understanding of PGP) and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing/switching).
  • Methodical troubleshooting aligned with OSI model; strong self-management and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to work in ambiguity and drive projects across multiple teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; no certifications required.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line efficiency improvements.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • Leadership mindset suitable for startup/tech environments; adaptable, resilient, and able to navigate ambiguity in a high-growth setting.

  • Collaborative and empathetic partner across functions and cultures.
  • Integrity and accountability in handling confidential information across diverse contexts; experience working remotely.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Growth opportunities with a comprehensive rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote-friendly policy: work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career with barriers removed so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value inclusivity and diversity. For accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process, please email Ledn team with details.

Ledn is a remote-first, global team spanning North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

description:
Por que ser Zappter?

  • Aqui você tem a oportunidade de colaborar em projetos que ajudam nossos clientes a superar desafios de negócios utilizando soluções tecnológicas.
  • Nossa cultura é 100% remota, e você pode trabalhar de qualquer lugar. Não é atoa que já estamos presentes em 18 estados do Brasil!
  • Trabalhará ao lado de pessoas que são apaixonadas pelo que fazem, tendo a chance de aprender diariamente e ampliar seus conhecimentos.
  • Nós Zappters cuidamos para crescer, conquistamos resultados com qualidade, inspiramos protagonistas e semeamos transformação. Somos presença que representa porque nossa harmonia vem de todas as vozes. Nossa cultura é nossa marca no mundo, é forte e autêntica.

Como será seu dia a dia?

Você será protagonista na construção da jornada de dados em um projeto estratégico e desafiador. Atuará desde a concepção até a entrega de pipelines eficientes, apoiando diretamente as áreas de negócio com dados confiáveis, métricas acionáveis e visão analítica. Seu papel envolve colaboração com stakeholders, entendimento de dores reais do negócio, além de um olhar técnico apurado para estruturar soluções escaláveis, modernas e sustentáveis.

  • Colaborar com times de produto e áreas funcionais para entender necessidades, desenhar soluções e apoiar decisões baseadas em dados.
  • Criar estruturas de dados voltadas a métricas, indicadores e painéis de acompanhamento.
  • Ser agente de conexão entre a engenharia e o negócio, antecipando gargalos e propondo caminhos de solução.
  • Automatizar processos e rotinas com Python e SQL, sempre com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Trabalhar com dados de múltiplas fontes (internas e externas), garantindo qualidade e integridade em todo o ciclo de vida.
  • Participar da definição da arquitetura de dados e evolução da stack tecnológica junto ao time de engenharia.

E, Para Tirar De Letra, Você Precisa

  • Experiência com engenharia de dados, ETL e construção de pipelines;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades do negócio em estruturas de dados e métricas relevantes;
  • Proatividade e habilidade de comunicação para navegar entre áreas, levantar requisitos e destravar pontos de bloqueio;
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados analíticos e boas práticas de governança;
  • Experiência em preparação e qualidade de dados, com aplicação de boas práticas de governança;
  • Conhecimento e experiência em Python aplicado à engenharia de dados;
  • Vivência com ambientes em nuvem (como AWS, GCP ou Azure), incluindo ingestão, tratamento e distribuição de dados;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização e BI (como Power BI, Looker, Tableau etc);
  • Familiaridade com segurança, ética e políticas de dados, alinhadas a boas práticas de compliance;
  • Habilidade para documentar pipelines, fluxos e arquitetura, garantindo reprodutibilidade e colaboração entre times.

Além disso, se tiver os itens abaixo, será ainda melhor!

  • Conhecimento em DataOps, versionamento e deploy de pipelines
  • Experiência prévia em projetos consultivos, com contato direto com cliente final
  • Experiência prévia em produtos digitais.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de mensageria e streaming, como Kafka;
  • Experiência com Hadoop, Hive e Spark em ambientes de Big Data;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade, como Grafana;
  • Experiência com arquiteturas modernas de dados e integração entre sistemas analíticos e operacionais

O que vamos te oferecer para que realize um trabalho incrível?

  • Sabe a vida fitness? Está garantida! Temos Wellhub (Gympas) para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental!
  • Também nos preocupamos com a sua saúde, por isso oferecemos o plano de saúde SulAmérica com cobertura nacional e sem mensalidade.
  • Queremos ver a felicidade estampada no seu rosto, por isso temos convênio odontológico para você ostentar aquele sorrisão!
  • Temos auxílio-creche para nossas mães e pais!
  • Somos flexíveis! Temos o Cartão Caju com bandeira Visa para sua alimentação ou refeição.
  • Zappters possuem aquele descontão! Oferecemos desconto de até 35% para compra em farmácias selecionadas.
  • Seguro de vida.

Para Apoiar Seu Dia a Dia

  • Atuação remote first, nossa tribo trabalha de qualquer lugar no Brasil.
  • Auxílio home office mensal todos os meses para investir em um setup incrível.
  • Voucher para Happy Hour & Fun com o time para celebrar as conquistas!

Para Desenvolver Sua Carreira

  • A cada 6 meses de empresa, você ganha um auxílio no valor de R$300 para investir na sua educação. Além de ter descontos incríveis na mensalidade de vários cursos.
  • Bônus meu mimo para deixar o momento da alteração salarial mais memorável! Você receberá um bônus no valor do seu aumento para comprar um presente especial para você.

Também é legal você saber que... Um dos nossos 7 valores é o Sawabona, seu significado é pra lá de especial, e praticado diariamente aqui na Zappts. A saudação #Sawabona se originou no Sul da África...

description:
Overview

Senior Graphic Designer (Contract) at Pocket Worlds. Remote location for LATAM candidates.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Graphic Designer with a strong background in digital art and illustration. You will be responsible for creating high-quality in-app promotional materials, social media content, and marketing creatives using our product’s avatars and digital assets. The ideal candidate has senior-level experience in digital asset creation, strong compositing skills, and a versatile portfolio that demonstrates range, consistency, and professional quality across styles. This role requires both creativity and adaptability—you should bring an AI-forward mindset, be eager to explore and leverage AI tools, and maintain polished, professional outputs without relying on obvious AI work. We’re looking for someone collaborative, low ego, and excited to iterate based on feedback to align with brand vision.

Location & Team

Location: Remote — LATAM
Team: Live Operations

Contract

The position is a contract role with an initial one-month period, with the possibility of renewal and extension based on performance and business needs.

Responsibilities

  • Create compelling digital visuals by styling and posing in-game assets.
  • Design graphics for product promotions, in-app releases, in-app posts, websites, social media, email campaigns, and internal projects.
  • Leverage AI tools and models to ideate, enhance, and polish creative content while maintaining professional quality.
  • Develop and maintain high standards for static graphics and visual storytelling.
  • Create reusable templates for in-app promotions and campaigns.
  • Innovate new approaches to presenting promotions and seasonal content.
  • Collaborate closely with art, product, and live operations teams to deliver creative solutions.
  • Manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment to consistently meet deadlines.
  • Proactively generate and suggest creative ideas to elevate the look and feel of the brand.
  • Stay current with digital design trends and incorporate them thoughtfully into your work.
  • Take full ownership for delivering quality work that meets both deadlines and brand objectives.

Requirements

  • Senior-level experience as a graphic designer or digital artist.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing versatility, compositing skills, and consistent quality across a range of digital design work. (Avoid portfolios limited to one style or heavy in print/traditional design.)
  • Expertise in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
  • Proven ability in character styling, lighting, effects, backgrounds, and mood/expressions.
  • Strong foundation in drawing, anatomy, perspective, and color theory.
  • Demonstrated skill in adapting to client/brand vision and iterating based on feedback.
  • Collaborative, low-ego approach with excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Self-driven with strong organizational and time management abilities.

Bonuses

  • Passion for fashion design.
  • Knowledge of Adobe After Effects and experience creating 2D animated promotional videos.
  • Experience with video editing.
  • Background in character art.

The position will start with an initial 1-month contract period, with the possibility of renewal and extension based on performance and business needs.

Há mais de 20 anos, a EVT é referência em soluções corporativas de TI, promovendo a transformação digital de seus parceiros e clientes. Com uma equipe altamente qualificada, atuamos tanto no desenvolvimento de soluções quanto na alocação de profissionais especializados dentro dos nossos clientes.

Atendemos grandes empresas dos mais diversos segmentos, sempre com foco em oferecer tecnologia de ponta, contato próximo e resultados que geram valor real para os negócios.

Na EVT, vivemos nossos valores no dia a dia: Respeito, Parceria, Eficiência, Inovação e Resultados. É isso que garante entregas de qualidade e relações duradouras com nossos clientes e colaboradores.

Se você busca um ambiente colaborativo, cheio de desafios que impulsionam sua carreira, venha fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza o talento e a dedicação de cada profissional!

Informações Da Oportunidade

  • Atuação: Remoto
  • Período: 3 meses com chance de prorrogação
  • Modelo de Contratação: CLT

Responsabilidades

  • Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Dados & Governança com sólida experiência em arquitetura de soluções, liderança técnica e governança corporativa em ambientes de dados modernos.
  • O(a) profissional terá como missão definir e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis em plataformas Lakehouse, promover boas práticas de governança e DataOps e atuar como líder estratégico para times técnicos e de negócio, conectando dados a valor corporativo em escala global.

Arquitetura De Soluções

  • Projetar arquiteturas Lakehouse modernas, utilizando plataformas como Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Lakehouse Federation).
  • Definir padrões de ingestão e transformação (batch, streaming, eventos) com Auto Loader, Structured Streaming, Liquid Clustering.
  • Modelar dados em arquiteturas Medallion (Raw, Silver, Gold), incluindo camadas de consumo (serving, APIs, BI, ML).
  • Estruturar integrações com sistemas legados, SaaS, SAP, DMS, ERPs e aplicações corporativas.
  • Apoiar projetos de Data Mesh e domínios de dados, com foco em escalabilidade e ownership.
  • Conectar dados a Analytics, Data Science e GenAI, viabilizando casos de uso avançados (predição, recomendação, copilots).
  • Avaliar e recomendar padrões arquiteturais (streaming-first, event-driven, real-time analytics).
  • Conduzir design reviews e provas de conceito para novas soluções de dados.
  • Apoiar estratégias de custo otimizado (compute, storage, caching, auto-scaling).
  • Documentar e disseminar blueprints corporativos de arquitetura de dados.

Governança e Estratégia

  • Definir e operacionalizar frameworks de Data Governance corporativa (catálogo, glossário, lineage, ownership, stewardship, qualidade).
  • Implantar políticas de segurança, privacidade e compliance (LGPD, GDPR, HIPAA), incluindo anonimização e criptografia.
  • Estabelecer políticas de classificação de dados (sensibilidade, retenção, criticidade) aplicadas em catálogos e camadas de dados.
  • Conduzir avaliações de maturidade em governança de dados e elaborar roadmaps de evolução. Apoiar o desenho e execução de modelos operacionais de governança (Hub & Spoke, centralizado, federado).
  • Introduzir automações de governança com Unity Catalog, AI/GenAI para classificação, lineage automático e sugestão de glossário.
  • Conduzir processos de definição de ownership e stewardship com áreas de negócio.
  • Estabelecer métricas e KPIs de governança (cobertura de catálogo, nível de qualidade, adoção de glossário, acessos).
  • Apoiar iniciativas de AI Governance, incluindo catalogação e ciclo de vida de modelos.
  • Atuar como ponte entre times de negócio, segurança e engenharia, garantindo adoção e alinhamento corporativo.

Liderança Técnica

  • Atuar como referência técnica e arquitetural, orientando engenheiros, analistas e cientistas.
  • Conduzir revisões de arquitetura e propor blueprints de dados corporativos.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre times técnicos e executivos.

DataOps e Automação

  • Implementar CI/CD de dados com GitLab/GitHub, Terraform e Databricks Asset Bundles.
  • Garantir qualidade de dados com testes automatizados (DQX, Pytest, SQLFluff).
  • Apoiar práticas de MLOps com MLflow, Feature Store e monitoramento de modelos.
  • Explorar uso de GenAI e automação inteligente em governança e qualidade.

Requisitos

  • Sólida atuação em Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Federation).
  • Domínio em Python para pipelines e automações.

  • Conhecimento em Data Governance, segurança e compliance.

Soft Skills

  • Perfil líder, colaborativo e influenciador, com capacidade de orientar e engajar times.
  • Comunicação executiva clara, traduzindo complexidade técnica em decisões de negócio.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

4 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

What You Bring to Ledn

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You'll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you're experienced with agile methods and sprints). You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn (continued): 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You have provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves: Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.) You've used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will: Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide: As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day! We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Our Environment & Application process

Ledn Working Environment Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Job details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Retail

title: Arquiteto de Segurança - Especialista
description:
Overview

Arquiteto de Segurança - Especialista, remoto/BR, na Projectiva Holding. Somos uma holding com empresas especializadas, entregando valor sob medida para cada desafio em transformação digital, inovação, ERP ou desenvolvimento. Buscamos um profissional para integrar o time com foco em soluções de segurança robustas e conformes às melhores práticas e regulamentações.

O que buscamos: um profissional com visão estratégica de segurança para colaborar com times de software, infraestrutura e operações, contribuindo com a melhoria contínua da postura de segurança da organização.

Responsabilidades

  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de segurança: projetar e garantir a implementação de arquiteturas de segurança robustas e escaláveis para aplicações e infraestrutura em ambientes Multi Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), alinhadas com as melhores práticas de mercado e requisitos regulatórios.
  • Apoiar no design seguro de sistemas: trabalhar com Arquitetos de Software e equipes de desenvolvimento para integrar segurança desde as etapas iniciais do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (Secure SDLC), realizando análises de ameaças (Threat Modeling) e revisões de design.
  • Garantir a segurança em ambientes Cloud e Contêineres: implementar e otimizar controles de segurança para plataformas Cloud (principalmente GCP, incluindo GKE, Cloud SQL), redes (VPCs, firewalls, micro-segmentação) e ambientes conteinerizados (Kubernetes), assegurando conformidade e proteção de dados.
  • Promover a cultura DevSecOps: colaborar para a integração de práticas de segurança nas esteiras de CI/CD (SAST, DAST, SCA, image scanning), automatizando verificações e garantindo deployments seguros por design.
  • Gerenciar Identidade e Acesso: projetar e implementar soluções de IAM, autenticação forte (MFA, SSO) e gestão de segredos para assegurar o princípio do menor privilégio.
  • Assegurar conformidade e auditoria: atuar para que as soluções estejam em conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentações externas (ex: LGPD, Bacen para clientes do setor financeiro), preparando ambientes para auditorias de segurança.
  • Documentar e disseminar conhecimento: criar e manter documentação técnica de segurança, padrões e guidelines, e atuar como referência para o time em decisões técnicas de segurança.
  • Visão estratégica e melhoria contínua: contribuir com a visão estratégica de segurança, identificar tendências e novas ameaças, propondo melhorias para a postura de segurança dos ambientes.

Qualificações / Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em Arquitetura de Segurança de aplicações e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento profundo em plataformas Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), com foco em serviços de segurança nativos (ex: Security Command Center, Security Hub, GuardDuty, WAF).
  • Domínio de Kubernetes Security (RBAC, Network Policies, image scanning, runtime security).
  • Experiência com DevSecOps e integração de segurança no pipeline de desenvolvimento.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e padrões de segurança (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, OWASP Top 10, Zero Trust).
  • Conhecimento em IAM, gestão de segredos, criptografia e proteção de dados.
  • Habilidade para Threat Modeling e análise de riscos.
  • Boa comunicação e proatividade para interagir com equipes multidisciplinares e stakeholders.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações de segurança (ex: CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, GCP Security Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500).
  • Experiência em segmentação de rede, VPNs e SD-WAN para ambientes híbridos e multi-cloud.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de segurança como SIEM/SOAR, CSPM e Vulnerability Scanners.
  • Experiência com automação de segurança via scripting (Python, Shell).
  • Histórico de atuação em clientes do setor financeiro e familiaridade com Bacen e LGPD.

O que oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de crescimento e aprendizado contínuo
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto
  • Contratação PJ ou Cooperado
  • DayOff no mês de aniversário
  • Descanso remunerado após 1 ano de contrato

Se você busca potencial humano, boas relações e um trabalho que impacta positivamente a vida das pessoas, venha fazer parte do nosso ecossistema. Venha ser um Projectiver!

title: Técnico de telecomunicações
description:
Resumo

O Técnico(a) em Telecomunicações ou Técnico(a) em Redes de Computadores é responsável por manter sistemas de telecomunicações e infraestrutura de rede, assegurando a disponibilidade, confiabilidade e segurança dos serviços de comunicação de dados e voz. Atua na configuração de equipamentos de rede, rádios, modems celulares, terminais satelitais e servidores de comunicação, garantindo conectividade local e remota.

Esse profissional desempenha papel essencial no suporte e manutenção da infraestrutura de redes corporativas, realizando diagnósticos, testes de desempenho, ajustes de configuração e registrando incidentes para garantir a continuidade operacional.

Responsabilidades

  • Manter sistemas de telecomunicações e infraestrutura de rede para assegurar disponibilidade, confiabilidade e segurança.
  • Configurar equipamentos de rede, rádios, modems celulares, terminais satelitais e servidores de comunicação.
  • Realizar diagnósticos, testes de desempenho, ajustes de configuração e registrar incidentes para garantir a continuidade operacional.

Conhecimentos e qualificações

  • Conhecimento básico em plataformas de monitoramento (ex.: Zabbix).
  • Conhecimento básico em plataformas de gestão de chamados (ex.: OTRS, ServiceNow, etc.).
  • Conhecimento básico em plataformas de visualização de dados (ex.: Grafana, Power BI, etc.).
  • Conhecimento básico em práticas de Cibersegurança e Segurança da Informação.
  • Nível básico em Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experiência anterior na área de TI e/ou central de monitoramento e incidentes/problemas (desejável).
  • Conhecimento em sistemas elétricos, automação, proteção e medição (desejável).
  • Conhecimentos técnicos desejados:
  • Sistemas de Telecomunicações: princípios básicos de transmissão de dados e voz, multiplexação, enlaces de rádio, satélite e celular.
  • Configuração de rádios: ajuste de frequências, largura de banda, potência, polarização e alinhamento de antenas.
  • Modelo OSI: entendimento das camadas físicas, de enlace, rede, transporte e aplicação, aplicando conceitos em troubleshooting.
  • Configuração de equipamentos de rede:
  • Switches: criação e gerenciamento de VLANs, configuração de STP, portas trunk e access.
  • Roteadores: configuração de rotas estáticas, protocolos de roteamento dinâmico (OSPF, BGP básico).
  • Terminal Server: configuração de acesso remoto seguro e tunelamento.
  • Modems celulares e satelitais: configuração de APNs, endereçamento IP, failover e redundância de links.
  • Segurança de rede: noções de firewall, ACLs e VPNs.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

What You Will Do / Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support via channels like Slack and Jira, delivering an outstanding experience for employees. All team members are on macOS.
  • Procuring and delivering technology equipment; owning the onboarding experience for new employees and the retrieval process for departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate recurring tasks. Manage and resolve critical incidents and issues as needed, from inception to completion.
  • Balance help desk tickets and prioritize effectively; work on projects over sprints and document work in Jira (familiar with Agile methods and sprints).
  • Set and work toward personal objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; know-how to work with APIs and integrate systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; knowledge of shipping/receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; ability to explain ideas clearly and assist users who may be frustrated or time-poor;
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email, and Slack; clear, friendly, concise communication, sensitive to different cultures.
  • Security-minded with knowledge of PGP; understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching); methodical OSI-model troubleshooting; ability to self-manage, scope projects, and work across teams.

Nice to Haves Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf, Okta, and Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit We look for a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values: integrity, accountability, progress, and empathy; able to work in a remote environment and influence across functions with clarity and empathy.

The Offer / What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package and opportunity for remote work worldwide up to 180 days.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company via equity; built-in opportunities for remote work and travel flexibility.
  • A purpose-driven role with a focus on inclusion, diversity, and equal opportunity employment.

Ledn is a global, remote-first company with teams across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.   • Conhecimento em modelagem de bancos de dados relacional e multidimensional;

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento na linguagem PySpark / Python;

  • Conceitos de metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento (SCRUM e / ou KANBAN).

Qualificações desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento e orquestração de pipelines de dados utilizando ADF (Azure Data Factory);

  • Conhecimento em arquitetura e aplicações Azure.

This includes day-to-day operations and product support, back office support and customer performance reporting, including Rules Management function which supports the structural foundation of the Visa Payments network.

Rules & Compliance team works to ensure the safety, security and integrity of the payment system and to support Visa clients in the development of their electronic payments business. Specifically, team establishes and enforces common interoperable rules and standards for our products and services by which clients must operate their Visa programs.

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice.

Qualifications

This is an operational position responsible for supporting the Notification Process by initiating and monitoring notification notices in alignment with the regulatory and strategic compliance objectives of Visa and its Clients. These objectives are defined by the Visa Charter Documents, Visa Core Rules & Product and Service Rules, associated Supplemental Requirements, the Visa do Brasil Regulamento (here referred to as Visa Rules), as well as the various laws governing the Payment System in Brazil.

The jobholder operates independently under moderate supervision and will influence other functions regarding practices, policies, and procedures related to rule compliance. The role is primarily accountable for supporting the team’s initiatives and tasks across the LAC region, with a focus on the Brazilian market, addressing all inquiries, potential violations, and other matters related to the Visa Rules. The position will manage internal and external relationships within the context of the Notification Process, escalating matters to Visa Rules senior management where appropriate, with the objective of minimizing brand and reputational risk to the Visa enterprise.

The jobholder will work on smaller projects under moderate supervision. While compliance issues are typically not highly complex, they may require an understanding of other operational areas and all Visa Processing Requirements. The role will engage with Visa staff and Clients to facilitate and ensure compliance with the Visa Rules.

Additional Information

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative - including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video - with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.

  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.

  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Manual Tester to join our dynamic team. This role is critical in ensuring the quality and reliability of our applications by verifying functionality against detailed specifications. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in the software development lifecycle by designing, executing, and managing comprehensive manual test plans and cases. Working closely with QA leads, developers, and business analysts, the Senior Manual Tester will help deliver robust, defect-free software solutions that meet and exceed customer expectations in a fast-paced Agile environment.

Responsibilities

  • Building, modifying, and executing detailed test plans, test cases, and scripts to validate application functionality. This includes covering both positive and negative scenarios to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
  • Identifying, reporting, and tracking defects through to closure using Azure DevOps Test Plan features. Collaborate with development teams to prioritize and resolve issues efficiently.
  • Actively participate in Agile Scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Review requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure clarity and testability.
  • Work closely with QA leads, developers, and business analysts to understand business needs and technical requirements, ensuring alignment and quality delivery.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation of test cases, test results, and defect reports to support transparency and traceability.
  • Perform thorough manual testing to validate new features and existing functionality, ensuring the software meets business and technical requirements.
  • While primarily focused on manual testing, understand automated test script execution and results to complement manual efforts and improve overall test coverage.
  • Provide regular updates on testing progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and resolution.
  • Contribute to process improvements in testing methodologies, tools, and best practices to enhance team efficiency and product quality.
  • SQL: Proficient in writing complex SQL queries to validate data integrity and support backend testing. Ability to analyze and manipulate data sets to verify application behavior.
  • Oracle PL/SQL: Strong experience with Oracle PL/SQL for database testing, including writing and executing stored procedures, functions, and triggers to validate business logic at the database level.
  • Microsoft Excel: Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, particularly with functions like VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP, to analyze test data, compare results, and generate reports efficiently.
  • Azure DevOps: Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps Test Plan features for managing test cases, executing tests, logging defects, and tracking progress within an Agile environment.
  • Manual Testing: Expertise in manual functional testing, including designing test cases, executing tests, and validating application features against requirements.
  • Functional Testing: Deep understanding of functional testing principles to ensure that software behaves as expected under various conditions.
  • Scrum: Active participation in Agile Scrum ceremonies, with a solid understanding of Agile methodologies and the ability to work effectively in iterative development cycles.
  • Defect Management: Skilled in identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and tracking defects to resolution, ensuring high-quality deliverables.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ultra Edit: Familiarity with Ultra Edit or similar advanced text editors to review and analyze code snippets, logs, or configuration files during testing.
  • PeopleSoft HCM: Experience with PeopleSoft Human Capital Management (HCM) systems, understanding core modules and workflows to better test related applications.
  • Benefits Module: Knowledge of Benefits modules within PeopleSoft or similar HR systems to validate features related to employee benefits administration.
  • Payroll Module: Understanding of Payroll modules and processes to effectively test payroll-related functionalities and integrations.

Job Description

Candidates must be fluent in English and submit their application in English to be considered.

Only those currently living in and authorized to work in Brazil are eligible. The application system will store candidate information. Once submitted, application details will be shared with Church Education System (CES) partners involved in the selection process. Applicants may receive a rejection email during or after review; however, unless a direct rejection is received from the hiring manager, applications will remain active and under consideration.

Responsibilities

  • The Computer Programming Course Instructor is an important part of the instructional team. With a strong focus on the academic success of every student, instructors use their subject matter expertise, deep understanding of the curriculum, and student population to:
  • Identify trends impeding academic success.
  • Conduct targeted outreach and provide instruction to target groups and individuals.
  • Build capable learners, confident in their ability to succeed academically and in life.
  • Instructors do not develop lessons or assessments, nor do they issue grades on student work (grading is handled by a centrally managed pool of qualified Graders).
  • Their focus is on the academic success of every student in their care.

Important: This is a part-time work-from-home position with the following flexible schedule:

  • 10-12 hours per week (may vary week-to-week)
  • At least 5 days worked each week
  • Required attendance at periodic team meetings (as established by the department)

Course Description

Teaching and mentoring students (using Python and C#) for:

  • CSE 110 - Introduction to Programming
  • CSE 111 - Programming with Functions
  • CSE 210 - Programming with Classes
  • CSE 212 - Programming with Data Structures

These courses provide students with foundational computer programming skills, enabling them to contribute to software development teams.

Position Summary

BYU Pathway and BYU Idaho online courses are structured to include both an instructor and graders. Instructors are responsible for teaching and overall course delivery, while graders support the learning process by reviewing and evaluating assignments and providing students with constructive feedback. We are seeking instructors who will apply their skills and subject matter expertise to mentor students and facilitate teaching/learning experiences.

Qualifications

NOTE : An applicant’s résumé and official transcripts will be used to determine eligibility to serve as an instructor for the Computer Programming courses. Please clearly highlight relevant education, professional work, and technologies on your résumé.

General Instructor Requirements

  • Deep understanding of and commitment to BYU Pathway Worldwide’s mission, defining characteristics, and student population.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (required).
  • Adaptability to new processes, procedures, and technologies.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills: professional, respectful, and unbiased in sensitive situations.
  • Proven reliability and ability to meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, video conferencing, and discipline-specific software.
  • Experience with online teaching/learning, especially with at-risk learners (preferred).

Specific Course Requirements: Computer Programming

  • A master’s degree in computer science or a related field and two years of professional software development experience is preferred.
  • A bachelor’s degree and 3-5 years of work experience may be considered.
  • Experience with Python, C#, or Java is required.
  • Expert proficiency with basic programming concepts, such as variables, data types, collections, loops, functions, libraries, I/O, error handling, and testing.
  • Expert proficiency with basic object-oriented programming concepts, such as classes, methods, variables, and access modifiers.
  • Familiarity with data structures and algorithms.
  • Understanding object-oriented principles, such as abstraction, encapsulation, polymorphism, and inheritance.
  • Experience with version control software, such as GitHub.
  • Experience with code editors, such as Visual Studio Code.
  • Ability to communicate clearly in writing.

Additional Documentation Requirement

Candidates advancing to the next stage of the hiring process will be required to provide the following academic documents:

  • Official transcript (histórico escolar) of a completed bachelor’s or master’s degree. The transcript must be sent directly from the awarding institution, either in digital or physical format. Transcripts submitted by the candidate, regardless of format, will not be considered official for accreditation or academic credential verification purposes. This process may take time and may involve additional expenses, depending on the institution.
  • Copy of diploma (front and back) showing the date of degree completion or the date of the graduation/commencement ceremony (data da colação de grau).

Academic documents issued by Brazilian or international institutions are acceptable, provided they are officially recognized in Brazil and the country of origin (Bacharelado, Licenciatura, Mestrado, Mestrado Profissional). Not applicable: in-progress transcripts and associate-level degrees. A completed bachelor’s degree is the minimum requirement for this position.

Documentação Adicional Requerida

Os Candidatos Que Avançarem Para a Próxima Etapa Do Processo Seletivo Deverão Apresentar Os Seguintes Documentos Acadêmicos

  • Histórico escolar oficial de bacharelado ou mestrado concluído.
  • O histórico deve ser enviado diretamente pela instituição de ensino responsável pela titulação, em formato digital ou físico.
  • Históricos enviados pelo próprio candidato, independentemente do formato, não serão considerados oficiais para fins de credenciamento ou verificação de títulos acadêmicos.
  • Observe que este processo pode demandar tempo e gerar custos adicionais.

HealthStream is an equal opportunity employer. HealthStream prohibits employment practices that discriminate against individual employees or groups of employees on the basis of age, color, disability, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, veteran or military status, genetic information or any other category deemed protected by state and/or federal law.

Position Information

Position Overview

The Success Manager plays a key role in driving customer success by cultivating strategic relationships with both internal and external stakeholders, delivering impactful business outcomes, and supporting the broader mission of empowering customers for transformational success.

This proactive, solution-oriented leader takes ownership of customer retention, growth, and value realization while collaborating across teams. The Success Manager is responsible for achieving key business metrics, fostering continuous improvement, and supporting strategic initiatives that drive both customer success and organizational growth, ensuring alignment with company goals and customer lifecycle needs.

The Success Manager sets the standard in managing high-value accounts, identifying opportunities for process improvements, and implementing customer-driven solutions. This role shares their subject matter expertise with peers and cross-functional partners, promotes a culture of collaboration, and supports initiatives that enhance both customer experience and internal efficiencies.

Key Responsibilities

You will be responsible for adhering to all HealthStream security policies, procedures, and assigned training.

  • Cultivates and maintains a consultative relationship with key customer stakeholders, ensuring satisfaction, adoption, product utilization, and progress towards organizational goals.
  • Interacts and builds relationships at various levels of customer organizations to identify their needs and work with them to find solutions that fit within their organizational strategy, culture, and constraints.
  • Advises assigned customers on best practices with a significant focus on the onboarding phase of the customer journey to ensure customers are set up to achieve their desired business outcomes and experience ongoing value realization.
  • Leverages customer data to analyze and proactively intervene to drive improvements in product adoption and utilization, both at scale and through personalized one-on-one engagement, ensuring long-term customer retention and growth.
  • Maintains documentation of customer engagement activities, risk status, and other relevant information to ensure visibility, accuracy of metrics, and effective automated processes.
  • Collaborates cross-functionally to deliver seamless customer experiences, share customer feedback for continuous improvement, and execute account renewal and risk remediation strategies to meet organizational retention targets.
  • Serves as a liaison with Product Management on user groups, product updates / rollouts, surveys, customer pilots, feedback, and joint webinars.
  • Maintains deep understanding of product design, performance metrics, and how products drive customer outcomes.
  • Partners with cross-functional teams to ensure that self-service resources are accurate, up-to-date, and meet customer needs.
  • Identifies and nurtures referenceable accounts and supports capture of customers’ success stories and ROI metrics.
  • Supports the onboarding of new team members and cross-functional colleagues.
  • Proactively identifies and addresses challenges or bottlenecks in customer processes, suggesting and implementing improvements.
  • Shares product knowledge with peers and cross-functional partners, fostering a collaborative learning environment.
  • Supports efforts to drive process improvements and strategic initiatives, both cross-functionally and within the Success team, to enhance customer outcomes and improve internal effectiveness.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Experienced professional with a minimum of a bachelor's degree in healthcare, business, technical, or related field
  • Minimum 2 years in a B2B customer success/sales or related role
  • Experience in a healthcare organization preferred
  • Experience with HealthStream products from an administrator level is a plus
  • Experience in a SaaS business highly desirable
  • Nursing degree, RN, and/or clinical experience preferred
  • Technical Expertise: Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Products; experience with a success management platform (such as Totango or Gainsight) is desirable.
  • Communication and Presentation Skills: Ability to effectively communicate and present complex ideas, strategies, and insights to executive-level internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment, building consensus, and fostering informed decision-making.
  • Data Fluency: Understanding of data and its application to defining customer success.
  • Customer Relationship Management: Ability to build and nurture strong, strategic relationships with both internal and external stakeholders to drive long-term customer success.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Demonstrated proficiency in analyzing customer data to identify trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities for growth and retention.
  • Confidence without Hubris: Ability to challenge existing approaches with expert recommendations in a diplomatic and nuanced manner to foster constructive dialogue and drive positive change, while recognizing the limits of one's own expertise and recognizing when to seek further guidance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong ability to collaborate with teams across departments (e.g., Sales, Product, Customer Support) to ensure cohesive strategies that align with customer success goals and organizational objectives.
  • Problem-Solving and Innovation: A solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to proactively identify problems and recommend creative, customer-driven solutions.
  • Leadership: Exhibits positivity and leads by example contributing to high team morale.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to understand and support strategic initiatives that align customer success with broader business objectives, demonstrating a commercially focused mindset and ensuring measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritization, Organization, & Execution: Exceptional time management and follow-through to successfully manage competing priorities and ensure impactful results.
  • Customer-Centric: Consistently prioritizes the customer experience, advocating for their needs and ensuring the delivery of value at every stage of the customer lifecycle.
  • Growth Mindset: Willingness to learn, grow, and continuously improve with an openness to feedback and opportunities for development.
  • Adaptable and Resourceful: Comfortable in a dynamic, innovative environment, able to think swiftly and pivot as needed to meet evolving business and customer needs.
  • Results-Oriented: Focused on driving business outcomes, with a strong emphasis on delivering tangible, measurable results.
  • Technically Savvy: Comfortable with technology to develop an in-depth understanding of HealthStream products/solutions.
  • Ability to Travel: Travel up to 20%, staying overnight as needed to meet customer and internal company needs.

Compensation

  • The salary range for this position is $70,352 - 100,000. Salary will be determined on the candidate’s level of experience and qualifications. Compensation will be commensurate with skills, relevant experience, and performance in similar roles.

  • Gestão de Equipes de InfoSec: Liderar, motivar e desenvolver o time de segurança, garantindo excelência técnica e evolução de carreira;

title: Finance Transformation Automation Associate
description:
Finance Transformation Automation Associate

Join to apply for the Finance Transformation Automation Associate role at dLocal

Overview

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets. By joining us you will be part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives.

What’s the opportunity?

  • We are seeking a Finance Transformation Automation Associate to drive the automation of financial and operational reconciliations. This role involves integrating data sources from banks and processors (APIs, SFTP, email), standardizing controls, and systematizing variance analysis to accelerate closes and reduce rework. The role blends financial–operational knowledge with skills in data ingestion services, and secure connectivity to move and validate data at scale. Success requires strong proficiency in Excel, familiarity with SQL and Python, and a strong focus on continuous improvement in an agile, fast-paced environment.

What will I be doing?

  • Integrate and maintain data sources from banks/processors via APIs, SFTP, and email workflows, ensuring data quality, completeness, and traceability
  • Execute and improve reconciliation controls for the different types of transactions supported by dashboards, matching rules, and audit evidence
  • Prepare and cleanse inputs (reconcilable groups, rules, sweeps), coordinating adjustments and new implementations with responsible teams
  • Analyze variances and differences across banks, processors, and internal records; conduct root-cause analysis and propose remedial actions and automation solutions
  • Develop analytical models (pivot tables, lookups; Power Query/Power Pivot, or equivalent) for KPIs, variance monitoring, and control tracking
  • Manage tickets and workflows in Jira for new reconciliations, rule/sweep changes, file uploads/removals, following strong documentation practices
  • Collaborate with Business Assurance, Operations, Treasury, Accounting, Product, and Data to resolve incidents, capture requirements, and coordinate UAT for new integrations
  • Standardize SOPs, strengthen controls, and scale end-to-end automations to reduce manual work, and rework during closes
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously in an agile context: gathering requirements, coordinating with stakeholders, performing UAT, and managing change

What skills do I need?

  • 2-4+ years in Finance Transformation, Treasury, Finance Operations, Engineering, or Process Automation, ideally within payments, fintech, or banking
  • Advanced Excel proficiency
  • Experience with SQL, Python and automation, with a track record of implementing tech-driven solutions
  • Experience with data ingestion and secure connectivity: APIs, SFTP, CSV/JSON; familiarity with VPN and SSH keys
  • Experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI) is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, ability to context-switch across multiple projects
  • Growth mindset with high adaptability, comfort with change, and an agile way of working
  • Excellent documentation and organizational skills
  • Fluent in spoken and written English

What do we offer?

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe*
  • Flexibility: flexible schedules and performance-driven culture
  • Fintech industry: dynamic environment with opportunities to build and boost creativity
  • Referral bonus program: employees can refer candidates and earn rewards
  • Learning & development: Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: monthly budget to engage with your team
  • dLocal Houses: option to rent a house and work remotely with your team
  • Location note: for Montevideo-based roles, attendance requirement at the office is 55% (not applicable to IT and Fraud roles)

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team will keep you posted by email at every step of the process.

Additional information

For more about dLocal, check our webpage, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube.

  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks; manage incidents to resolution.

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.; experience with open-source tooling (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows within Okta; strong API integration skills.

Culture and Benefits

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.

You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta). You will create solution documentation and automation to reduce manual work. You will manage incidents and tickets, prioritize workload, and participate in projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn: 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite). Automation skills (bash, zsh, python). Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.). Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows, and work with APIs to connect systems. Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs. Excellent written and verbal communication across media. Ability to draft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages. Comfort with security principles and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model). Self-management with the ability to scope work and coordinate across teams. Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package, remote-friendly with up to 180 days remote eligibility (subject to restrictions); ownership in the company through equity; a purpose-driven career; inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employer. We welcome accommodation requests via email for recruitment process stages; responses are confidential.

Company and Hiring Notes

Ledn’s team is global, remote-first, with presence across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Staff Application Security Engineer role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Ledn offers egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Our team is diverse and values integrity, accountability, progress, and empathy. We are building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services.

We are seeking a full-time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

The role involves working across JavaScript/TypeScript services, an AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices. You will evolve our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches and design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated environments.

The Opportunity

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values of integrity, progress, and empathy.

The Ideal Candidate Will

Overview

  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.

  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).

  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Have

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

Why join us: If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

As a Python Engineer at AgileEngine, you will enhance and scale our Python-based ServiceNow tools, develop and maintain integrations, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver efficient, reliable solutions. You’ll work with modern Python frameworks like Django , FastAPI , and Celery , ensuring code quality and performance while contributing to AI-powered workflows that optimize business processes.

  • Develop and maintain ServiceNow integrations;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements;
  • Design, develop, and test ServiceNow applications;
  • Troubleshoot and resolve ServiceNow issues;
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest ServiceNow features and functionality.

Must have

  • 4+ years of experience working in software development with Python ;
  • Experience with Celery, Django, or FastAPI ;
  • EST timezone availability;
  • Excellent English and communication skills;
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team;
  • Experience working in an Agile development environment.

Nice to have

  • Some experience either doing integrations or building modules within ServiceNow;
  • Experience working with AI.

Perks and benefits

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.

Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring). Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks. Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10+ years of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.

  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals and remediation of vulnerabilities identified in penetration tests.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
